inputs.sbc_source: J-GAAP consolidated cash flow statement (yuho FY2026, 5332.T_Annual_FY2026.txt:5105-5135) carries no share-based payment line; restricted-stock and option grants are immaterial (treasury-share disposals for awards JPY155m in FY2026, dilutive options 68 thousand shares). SBC held at an explicit 0% row.
inputs.share_count_basis: Issued 166,358,397 less treasury 1,942,038 at 2026-03-31 (yuho FY2026 lines 2378, 2460) = 164.416m, plus 68k dilutive stock options (EPS note line 7323) = 164.48m fully diluted. Held FLAT: SBC is zero so there is nothing to dilute, and the FY2026 JPY20.0bn buyback (5.31m shares, cancelled) is treated as value-neutral capital return, not a projected count reduction.
inputs.wacc_rationale: JPY-denominated flows discounted at a JPY-built rate: 10y JGB ~1.6%, Japan ERP ~6%, beta ~0.9 for a net-cash consumer-durables/building-products maker gives a cost of equity ~7.0%; 0.5pp added for the China restructuring and semiconductor-cycle exposure of the profit mix. Debt is ~7% of EV at ~1% so the blended WACC rounds to 7.5%. Same WACC in all three scenarios; risk is carried in the scenario flows and weights (charged once).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A), leases as debt. J-GAAP: operating lease rentals are already expensed inside operating profit, so no principal deduction in the flows. The JPY6,582m of finance-lease liabilities (2,385 current + 4,197 non-current, yuho line 7359-7365) is excluded from total_debt (which matches the DB: short-term loans 23,271 + CP 43,200 + long-term loans 1,314 = 67,785) and is instead deducted once in equity_bridge.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated (segment OP basis). Non-controlling interests of JPY5,687m (yuho line 4883, ~1% of equity) are deducted once in equity_bridge; NCI profit share is immaterial (NCI dividends JPY387m in FY2026).
inputs.non_operating_assets: Interest income (JPY865m) and dividend income (JPY1,997m) are outside operating profit and therefore outside the EBITDA-margin build; their source assets go into the bridge: cash via net_debt, listed investment securities at fair value net of the tax on the latent gain, equity-method affiliates at book. The net defined-benefit pension surplus (assets 72,393 less liabilities 16,556) is NOT added -- it is not freely distributable and its exclusion is a deliberate conservatism worth roughly JPY240/share after tax.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing: operating company, non-US, cyclical -> owner-fcf.md + owner-fcf-adaptations.md). TOTO is a sanitaryware/plumbing-fixtures manufacturer with a fast-growing semiconductor-ceramics segment; it is not a bank, REIT or holdco, so the default engine applies with the SBC-zero, lease, NCI and non-operating-asset adaptations. FY0 = FY2026 (year ended 2026-03-31): revenue 737,441; operating profit 53,759; D&A 34,360 (EBITDA 88,119, 11.95%); capex 43,158 (tangible 36,476 + intangible 6,682); cash tax paid 15,864 (29.5% of EBIT). Owner FCF = reported FCF 28,082 - SBC 0 - interest income 865 = 27,217. FY2026 inventories released JPY14.2bn into OCF (one-off destocking) which is why FY0 reported FCF sits above the component-built year-1 figure; the forward build uses a negative working-capital capture, as a manufacturer should. FY2027 guidance (results release 2026-04-30, carried in the Analysis JSON): sales JPY785.0bn (+6.5%), OP JPY60.0bn (7.6% margin), net income JPY46.0bn; the base case takes ~6% / 12.2% EBITDA margin, a light haircut for the tariff and China execution risk the company itself flagged. SBC-zero market: house and street bases coincide and band_position is null by construction. Price is the regular TSE close, not an after-hours print. Balance sheet, share count and debt are all from the 2026-03-31 yuho (filed 2026-06-16); the H1 FY2027 (Sept-2026) results were not in the extracted set at build time -- the first evidence that would move the year-1 driver is that interim's progress against the JPY60bn OP guide.

equity_bridge.item: Listed investment securities at fair value, net of ~30.6% tax on the latent gain
equity_bridge.note: Fair value 49,854 (yuho FY2026 line 5914) less tax on pre-tax unrealised gain ~38,100 (OCI 26,455 after tax, line 4878). Matching asset for the stripped dividend income.
Investment securities in affiliates 10,678 shares + 608 contributions (yuho line 5481-5482).
Yuho line 4883; charged once here, flows are consolidated.
2,385 current + 4,197 non-current (yuho line 7359-7365); excluded from total_debt, treatment (A).

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 7.6% is ~55% above revenue 5yr CAGR 4.9%: the gap is retained earnings plus OCI (FX translation +JPY61.8bn cumulative, securities revaluation, pension remeasurement), not operating growth, so equity CAGR is rejected as the growth anchor. EPS 5yr 8.7% is flattered by a depressed FY2021 (COVID) base and FY2026 securities gains.
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs are FY2021->FY2026 (5yr) and FY2023->FY2026 (3yr) on the owner-FCF series (reported FCF less interest income; SBC is zero throughout). Owner FCF: FY2021 15,005; FY2023 -6,053 (capex supercycle year, negative so no 3yr CAGR); FY2026 27,217. The 5yr owner-FCF CAGR of 12.6% is a trough-to-destocking-year artefact (FCF ranged -6,053 to 27,217 over the period) and is not used. Revenue 3yr of 1.7% reflects China contraction and flat Japan masking +34%/yr ceramics growth.

base.narrative: Year 1 tracks FY2027 guidance with a light haircut (sales +6.0% vs +6.5% guided; EBITDA 12.2% = OP ~7.6% guided + D&A 4.6%). China reaches breakeven over FY2027-28 (+0.9pp of margin from the FY2026 JPY6.9bn loss), ceramics keeps growing in the high teens for three years then normalises, Japan margin stops falling but is not repaired; net EBITDA margin matures at 13.3%, inside the FY2018 (12.5%) to FY2022 (12.3%) range plus mix. Capex glides from 6.0% to 5.3% as the Morrow and ceramics capacity programmes complete, still above D&A. Terminal growth 1.5% (Japan structural decline offset by overseas washlet penetration and JPY inflation); cap 15x FCF binds over Gordon (1.015/0.060 = 16.9x).

bull.narrative: Guidance beaten: ceramics (electrostatic chucks) compounds 20%+ through the AI logic capex cycle and reaches ~12% of sales at 40%+ segment margins; China turns profitable after the ~40% capacity cut; the Americas price through tariffs on Morrow-plant supply and washlet penetration keeps growing in e-commerce/retail; the Japan profitability programme management promised for FY2030 actually lifts Japan HE margin back toward 5-6%. EBITDA margin matures at 14.5%, the FY2018 peak plus the ceramics mix shift. Terminal growth 2.0%.

bear.narrative: The semiconductor memory softness management flagged becomes a ceramics down-cycle in FY2028 (segment sales fall, taking ~40% of group OP with it); China breakeven slips again and restructuring charges recur; US tariffs are absorbed rather than passed on; Japan HE margin keeps eroding versus LIXIL as new housing starts decline, with the remodel pivot only slowing the decline. Revenue grows ~1-1.5% and EBITDA margin settles at 10.8%, just under the FY2024 trough (10.95%). Capex stays at 5.8% because the capacity already built has to be maintained. Terminal growth 1.0%.

scenario_narratives.base: FY2027 guidance roughly delivered (sales ~JPY782bn, EBITDA ~12.2%); China breakeven by FY2028, ceramics growth decelerating from +34% to high-teens then mid-single digits, Japan Housing Equipment margin flat rather than repaired. Group EBITDA margin matures at 13.3% by year 6, revenue growth decays from 6% to 2%, capex normalises to 5.3% of sales. Terminal 1.5% growth, capped at 15x year-10 owner FCF.
scenario_narratives.bull: Ceramics becomes a durable second pillar through the AI capex cycle, China returns to profit after the capacity cut, Morrow-plant supply lets the Americas price through tariffs, and the FY2030 Japan profitability programme actually lifts the core segment. Margin matures at 14.5%, growth decays from 7.5% to 2.5%, terminal 2.0%.
scenario_narratives.bear: Ceramics turns down with the memory cycle in FY2028, China breakeven slips with recurring charges, tariffs absorbed, Japan margin erosion continues with demographic decline. Growth ~1-1.5%, EBITDA margin settles at 10.8%, capex stays at 5.8%, terminal 1.0%.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25%: the Japan HE margin decline is management-acknowledged and structural, ~40% of FY2026 operating profit now comes from a semiconductor-capex-cyclical segment at what may be a cycle high, and China breakeven has already slipped once; none of these is a solvency risk (net cash JPY63bn, no SBC) so it stops at 25%. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs four independent things to go right at once (ceramics cycle persists, China fix, tariff pass-through, Japan margin repair). Base 50%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF on consolidated operating profit with zero SBC, interest and dividend income stripped and their source assets (net cash, listed cross-shareholdings after tax, affiliates) added in the bridge; finance leases and NCI deducted once; a JPY-built 7.5% WACC held constant across scenarios so risk is priced only in the scenario flows and the 25/50/25 weights. Terminal value capped at 15x year-10 owner FCF rather than Gordon, which is where the method puts a slow-growing manufacturer. The pension surplus is excluded as a deliberate conservatism.
key_risks_to_valuation: Semiconductor ceramics cycle: the segment is ~7% of sales but ~40% of operating profit (FY2026 segment OP JPY28.9bn of 53.8bn); a memory/logic capex downturn removes most of the margin expansion in the base case
Japan Housing Equipment (~66% of sales) margin erosion is structural and unrepaired; the base case only assumes it stops falling
Mainland China: FY2026 operating loss JPY6.9bn with ~JPY15bn of restructuring charges; breakeven targeted for FY2027 but execution has slipped before
US tariffs: ~JPY2bn direct OP hit already in FY2026 guidance; further escalation or failure to price through compresses the Americas segment

Capex intensity: FY2024-26 capex ran 5.9-8.3% of sales against D&A of 4.7%; if the capex-above-D&A gap does not close as modelled, owner FCF stays near FY2026's JPY27bn rather than reaching JPY50bn by year 10
FX: a wide basket (USD, CNY, EUR, TWD, VND, THB, INR) moves reported segment profit; the model is in JPY and takes no view on rates
